free_tier.stated: Per-file 20 MB on free accounts, 2 GB on paid. No published account total: 'Generally, there is no limit on how many files you can upload.' HubSpot's own catalog does not state a storage figure.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.notes: extracted from the quota or limits prose

retention.stated: Request-rate: 100 req / 10 s / app and 250,000 / day per account on Free ('Privately distributed apps, Free and Starter, 100/app, 250,000/account'). Retention: none documented. Files persist until deleted.

egress.terms: Free, Cloudflare-fronted. `hubfs` files are served publicly with `Accept-Ranges: bytes`, `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`, `Cache-Control: s-maxage=2592000`.

tooling: Files API (`POST /files/2026-09/files`, multipart), public URL in the response's `defaultHostingUrl` / `url`. Python/Node SDKs. No rclone backend.
chaining: 20 MB/file x unlimited files x unlimited free HubSpot accounts. Weak on its own; becomes usable only at portal scale or if you can get onto 2 GB/file.

Retention: none documented. Files persist until deleted. Download URLs can 429 if the rate limit is exceeded.
